reason: Booking and Airbnb scheduled messages plus my printed rules sheet already answer the Wi-Fi and parking questions, and my guests come back because they talk to me, not a robot. With four or five apartments that is €150 or more a month and €600 setup for something I think I already have covered.
objection: Guests like the personal touch with me, and I worry a chatbot gets something wrong or makes my place feel like a hotel chain. Paying per apartment adds up fast on my income.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle a real August week of German messages for a neighbour I trust, with one price for all my apartments instead of per unit.
